messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up - consolidating remediation owners and timelines from yesterday's DR postmortem. Posting current snapshot so we can track.

Connor: Thanks Maya. One ask: include the specific failure signatures (error codes / logs) next to items so we can detect recurrence.

Maya: Good call. I'll add a short "recurrence pattern" note for each item.

Lina: I'll take ownership of the restore runbook rewrite. Owner: Lina. Deliverable: single canonical MD with step-by-step and validation checks. Due: 2025-01-09.

Derek: I'll own multi-region routing guardrails. Owner: Derek. Action: add policy to smart-router to prefer healthy-region with latency threshold and fallback weighting. Ticket: ROUTE-208. ETA: 2025-01-11.

Maya: Backups: verify cross-region replication and add automated retention enforcement. Owner: Connor + BackupTeam. Ticket: INFRA-3492. Smoke restore test: 2025-01-07.

Connor: Note: recurring pattern observed 15xx on restore attempts when snapshot metadata mismatches. I'll include grep-able log snippets in the ticket.

Lina: Runbook additions: pre-failover cache-warm step + TLS cert propagation verification. I'll include sample commands and expected outputs.

Maya: Game day proposal: 2025-01-18 08:30 PT. Scenario: EU primary outage -> NA failover -> restore EU. Owners should be present for their steps. ops-bot, please create #gd-2025-01-18 and invite owners.

ops-bot: Channel #gd-2025-01-18 created. Calendar event sent to Lina, Derek, Connor, Maya.

Derek: For autoscaling lag we saw, action: reduce scale-out cooldown from 120s to 60s for critical pools and add a proactive burst capacity of +25%. Owner: PlatformTeam. Ticket: PLAT-645.

Connor: I'll add automated retention enforcement for snapshots and a periodic audit job that reports drift. Owner: BackupTeam. Cron: daily.

Lina: Added a checklist item: verify cert CN matches SNI and that edge LB certs replicate within 2 minutes. Command example:
openssl s_client -servername api.eu.redwood.com -connect api.eu.redwood.internal:443
Expect: Certificate subject CN=api.redwood.com

Maya: Please post progress updates as short one-liners in this thread. I'll update the owners matrix doc and mark items closed when verified. Target checkpoint for updates: EOD 2025-01-05.

Connor: ack. Will post snapshot verification results by 2025-01-04.

Derek: ack. Starting routing policy PR today, will request review by 2025-01-06.

Lina: ack. Drafting the runbook now, will link PR when ready.

Maya: Reminder: include recurrence evidence in tickets (time-of-day, deployment windows, identical stack traces) so SRE can tune alerts.

Connor: FYI I saw most recurrences within 20 minutes after deploys to EU, correlates with cache rehydration events. Adding that note.

Derek: Also noticed route table convergence spikes correlated with control-plane upgrades. Logging that in ROUTE-208.

Maya: Great. If no blockers, we'll run the game day dry-run 2025-01-15 and live run 2025-01-18. Owners: be prepared to show your steps.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run on 2025-01-15 at 08:00 PT.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now 1 will compile owners matrix and ping if anything slips.
